function: Jointly predicts IRS phase shifts and reader transmit beamforming to maximize backscatter SNR (p. 6, p. 7).
system: Monostatic backscatter: reader with M=4 antennas, single-antenna tag, passive reflecting IRS with N=16 to 50 elements, 915 MHz (p. 4, p. 10).
method: Deep residual CNN (BackIRS-Net) trained offline with unsupervised learning, loss equal to negative received SNR (p. 7, p. 9).
data_channel: Custom simulation: i.i.d. Rician fading, K-factor 3 dB, path-loss exponent 2.5; 10^5 channel samples split 80:10:10 (p. 10).
test_conditions: Trained and tested on same Rician distribution (held-out 10% split); network size depends on N and M; no unseen-condition test stated (p. 8, p. 10).
baselines: No IRS; random IRS phase with MRT/MRC; MM-SDR optimization; learned 5-layer MLP (p. 11).
metrics: Effective backscatter SNR at the reader (dB), range extension, run time (p. 10, p. 11, p. 12).
complexity: SDR O(I(k+2)^4.5) vs BackIRS-Net O(k^2); N=50 run time 62.2 ms (SDR), 9.23 ms CPU, 2.63 ms GPU (p. 9, p. 10, p. 11).
q1_support: p. 5: "independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) Rician fading". Custom Rician simulator (K-factor 3 dB, p. 10); no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, DeepMIMO or measured channel is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 10: "it is tested on the unseen test data set". This is a held-out part of the same data; the paper never states a test on another scenario, band, array size or site.
q3_support: p. 11: "v and w obtained by a trained MLP (5 layers with 20N neurons in each and each layer followed by ReLU and BN)"; p. 11: "the plot for the SDR based approach sits at the highest SNR"
q4_support: p. 10: "only has a computational complexity of O(k 2 )"; p. 10: "it takes only 2.63 ms" (Table 5, p. 11: 62.2 ms for MM-SDR, 9.23 ms on CPU).
q5_support: p. 10: "which split into training, validation and test data in the ratio of 80 : 10 : 10". The dataset is self-generated from the Rician simulator; no code or data link and no public channel dataset appear.
notes: Backscatter IoT link with a passive IRS; area 3 because the learned network sets IRS phases and reader beamformer jointly. MLP counted as the fully connected learned baseline (the authors' earlier work [30] uses an MLP, p. 7; p. 11). Fig. 6 (p. 12) sweeps IRS position but does not say whether the network was retrained or tested at unseen positions, so q2 stays 0.
